Best Practices Azure Experts Use to Check System Performance

Perform Static Code Analysis

Run static analysis to identify potential vulnerabilities. Apply manual techniques like taint checking and data flow analysis.

Perform Code Reviews

Conduct code reviews before check-in to increase code quality and reduce bugs. Use Visual Studio for managing reviews.

Validate and Sanitize Input

Treat all input as untrusted to prevent injection attacks. Use allowlisting for secure validation. Perform validation server-side.

Verify Application Outputs

Encode and escape outputs to prevent injection attacks (e.g., XSS). Use OWASP XSS prevention techniques.

Use Parameterized Queries

Prevent SQL injection by using parameterized queries or stored procedures instead of inline queries.

Remove Standard Server Headers

Suppress headers like Server, X-Powered-By to prevent fingerprinting and exposure of server details.

Segregate Production Data

Use masked (anonymized) Azure data for development and testing to minimize security risks.

Implement Strong Password Policies

Enforce complex passwords and manage them with Azure AD B2C. Ensure generated passwords have high entropy.

Validate File Uploads

Use OWASP guidelines to validate uploaded files. Implement antimalware protection with Microsoft Defender.

Avoid Caching Sensitive Content

Prevent sensitive data from being stored in browser caches to avoid unauthorized access.
